summary: Lixiang Education Holding filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited first-half 2026 results, not a special-situation event. Net revenues were RMB15.2 million (US$2.2 million) versus RMB15.4 million a year earlier, with tuition down 12.8% to RMB7.9 million on enrollment pressure. Gross profit turned positive at RMB2.7 million versus a RMB5.0 million loss, aided by RMB7.8 million lower costs including headcount reductions at Langfang School. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed; this is routine periodic reporting.
